description: We are five CS students building the Lunar Landing Site Navigator around one question: will a lander survive where it touches down? Our project combines a battery Survival Mode simulation, landing uncertainty probabilities, and a 3D radio link beam. Our skills span AI/ML, computer vision, 3D graphics, backend, and dashboards, and we won first place at Smart City Hackathon Lahore. We seek help with orbital mechanics, lunar datasets (LRO, LOLA), and Python simulation.
